description: A different way to end up with no evidence for Clause 2 than case04's perimeter-NGFW blind spot: here the passive tap DOES capture area-to-area traffic, but no switch ACL configuration was ever exported or exists for this core switch, so there is no documented policy to compare the traffic against. A compliance verdict needs both a policy and evidence side; only evidence exists here.

flows.notes: Traffic exists between two areas, but with no switch ACL export available this cannot be attributed to a permitted rule or flagged as unauthorized -- there is nothing documented to check it against.

notes: policy_file is intentionally null: this utility's core switch ACLs were never handed over during evidence collection, a realistic gap for smaller water systems per the paper's own discussion of SIEM adoption gaps in the sector.
